model.displayFrame: Earth-fixed PEF approximation using GMST, UTC approximates UT1; polar motion omitted
model.geography: WGS84 ellipsoid; public-domain Natural Earth geography from the existing edition
model.eligibility: Absolute element offset <=24 hours at each displayed UTC. Invalid and wholly stale records excluded; changing eligibility retained. No age-to-error conversion.
model.sampling: Direct SGP4 from a cloned baseline at each displayed instant; no state interpolation. Numerical scan every 60 seconds including eligible bounds.
model.scope: Thirty-minute contemporary aftermath snapshot. Collision date is documented context; no reconstruction, historical evolution, risk or optical visibility claim.

rights.attribution: CelesTrak; USSPACECOM / 18th Space Defense Squadron via Space-Track.org.
rights.fieldProvenance: Standard GP/OMM fields retained. Group association checked against source group, OBJECT_NAME, International Designator prefix and the two original NORAD identities; this is provider-labelled association, not independently established fragment genealogy. No optional status or physical-properties enrichment.
rights.changes: UTC suffix and explicit documented Earth/TEME/UTC/SGP4 defaults; decimal-string NORAD identities; eligibility bounds and per-record roles added.
